summary: The StaffMessages system manages staff messages, including retrieval, addition, updating, and deletion of messages associated with staff using stored procedures.
purpose: To handle the addition, updating, deletion, and retrieval of staff messages within the system, ensuring messages are valid and associated with staff.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the staff message.

fields.name: StaffID
fields.description: Identifier for the staff member associated with the message.

fields.name: TypeCodeID
fields.description: Identifier for the type of message.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name or nickname associated with the message.

fields.name: Message
fields.description: The content of the staff message.

fields.name: TypeCodeDesc
fields.description: Description of the message type, potentially in alternate languages.

fields.name: MessageFormatted
fields.description: Formatted version of the message, truncated to 50 characters.

actors.name: HSPnetSession
actors.role: Handles database sessions and operations, including executing stored procedures and managing message validity checks.

workflows.name: Add Staff Message
steps: Create a StaffMessage object with StaffID, TypeCodeID, Name, and Message.
Check if the message is valid using the IsValid method.
If valid, set the database procedure to 'StaffMessagesAdd'.
Add parameters (StaffID, TypeCodeID, Name, Message) to the procedure.
Execute the query to add the new message.

workflows.name: Update Staff Message
steps: Create a StaffMessage object with ID, StaffID, TypeCodeID, Name, and Message.
Check if the updated message is valid using the IsValid method.
If valid, set the database procedure to 'StaffMessagesUpdate'.
Add parameters (ID, StaffID, TypeCodeID, Name, Message) to the procedure.
Execute the query to update the message.

workflows.name: Delete Staff Message
steps: Check if the ID is greater than 0.
Add the ID parameter to the procedure.
Execute the query to delete the message.

workflows.name: Search Staff Messages by ID
steps: Add the ID parameter to the procedure.
Retrieve data and populate a list of StaffMessage objects if results exist.

business_rules: Staff message must be associated with a valid StaffID and TypeCodeID.
Name and Message fields must not be blank.
validations: Check if StaffID, TypeCodeID are not null.
Name and Message must not be blank (checked using StringUtil).
system_behavior: The system uses stored procedures for different operations on staff messages.
It validates messages to ensure all required fields are populated before operations.
dependencies: Database: For executing stored procedures and managing data operations.
HSPnetSession: For session management and language-specific operations.
exceptions: If ID is 0 in 'StaffMessagesSearchID', return an empty list.
If any required field is missing during validation, appropriate errors are added to session messages.
